subject.title: feat(gateway): typed structured questions on openclaw.chat with live option cards

question: Should `system-agent.chat.question` be accepted as the durable cross-client gateway presentation contract for structured onboarding and wizard choices?
rationale: The branch deliberately expands a public gateway response and generated Swift model; the roadmap context supports typed actions, but maintainers must confirm the permanent wire boundary and native-client rollout expectation.

options.title: Confirm the additive contract
options.body: Accept `question` as the permanent optional response field, preserve prose fallback behavior, and merge after required checks complete.

options.title: Narrow the presentation boundary
options.body: Keep the custodian capability but request a more scoped transport or client-owned shape before adding it to the general gateway response.

options.title: Pause for protocol design
options.body: Defer the feature until maintainers document the intended cross-client presentation-action model and versioning expectations.

recommendation.title: Confirm the additive contract
recommendation.body: Accept `question` as the permanent optional response field, preserve prose fallback behavior, and merge after required checks complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history identifies this contributor as the only directly evidenced owner of the proposed protocol and UI implementation; a gateway/protocol reviewer should make the final product decision.
